name: mldsa
description: ML-DSA (FIPS 204) post-quantum digital signatures for ESP32. All three security levels (ML-DSA-44/65/87), built on mldsa-native v2.0.0. About 3 KB of stack and 9 to 22 KB of heap per operation, a registrable random source, and key storage in NVS.
keywords: post-quantum, cryptography, digital-signature, mldsa, dilithium, fips204, pqc, lattice, mldsa44, mldsa65, mldsa87
